meaning.sw: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, mshushie rehema Muhammad ﷺ, mja Wako na Mtume Wako, Nabii asiyejua kusoma wala kuandika, na juu ya jamaa zake Muhammad. Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, mshushie rehema Muhammad ﷺ na jamaa zake rehema itakayokuwa radhi Kwako, malipo kwake, na kutekeleza haki yake; na umpe al-Wasilah, ubora, na Cheo cha Kusifiwa (al-Maqam al-Mahmud) ulichomwahidi; na umlipe malipo bora kabisa kuliko uliyowahi kumlipa Nabii kwa ajili ya watu wake na Mtume kwa ajili ya umma wake; na uwape rehema ndugu zake wote miongoni mwa Manabii na watu wema, ewe Mwingi wa rehema.

source.original_recitation: અલ્લાહુમ્મ સલ્લી અલા મુહમ્મદીન્ અબ્દીક વ રસુલીકન્ નબીય્યીલ્ ઉમ્મીય્યી વ અલા આલી મુહમ્મદીન્ અલ્લાહુમ્મ સલ્લી અલા મુહમ્મદીન્ વ અલા આલી મુહમ્મદીન્ સલાતન્તકુનુ લક રિજ઼્યીવ્વલહુ જજ઼ાઅવ્વલિ હક્કીહી આદાઅવ્ વઅતીહી લિવસીલત વલ્ ફજ઼િલત વલ્ મકામલ્ મમુદલ્લજ઼ીવ્ વઅદ્દતહુ વઅજ્ જ઼ીહી વ અફ્જ઼લ માજાજ઼ૈત નબીય્યન્ અન્ કૌમીહી વરસુલન્ અન્ ઉમ્મતીહી વ સલ્લી અલા જમીઈ ઈખ્વાનિહી મીનન્નબીય્યીન વસ્સાલિહીન યા અર્હમરાહીમીન

review_notes: Well-known Salawat recorded in classical collections (e.g., Dala'il al-Khayrat & Musnad/athar traditions). Minor Gujarati transliteration typos ('મમુદલ્લજ઼ીવ્' for al-mahmuda alladhi, 'લિવસીલત' for al-wasilata, 'આદાઅવ્' for ada'an, and extra 'વ' before 'અફ્જ઼લ') corrected against attested Arabic.

dhikrs.en_full_name: Jazallahu 'anna Sayyidana Muhammadan sallallahu ta'ala 'alayhi wa alihi wa sallam bima huwa ahluh
dhikrs.en_fazilat: The source cites Imam 'Abd al-Wahhab al-Sha'rani (rahimahullah) in al-Mizan as narrating that whoever recites this Durood Shareef once receives such immense reward that even if 1,000 angels were to write its reward for 70 days—or 70 angels for 1,000 days—they would not be able to finish recording it.
dhikrs.guj_short_name: દુરૂદ પઢવા પર 1,000 ફરિશ્તા સવાબ લખે છે
dhikrs.guj_full_name: જઝલ્લાહુ અન્ના સૈયદીના મુહમ્મદન સલ્લલ્લાહુ તઆલા અલયહી વ આલીહી વસલ્લમ બિમા હુવ અહ્'લુહુ
dhikrs.guj_fazilat: મૂળ સ્ત્રોતમાં હઝરત અબ્દુલ વહાબ શઅરાની રહમતુલ્લાહિ તઆલા અલયહિના હવાલાથી 'મીઝાન'માં નકલ કરવામાં આવ્યું છે કે જે વ્યક્તિ આ દુરૂદ શરીફ એક વખત પઢશે તેને એટલો સવાબ મળશે કે જો 1,000 ફરિશ્તા 70 દિવસ સુધી અથવા 70 ફરિશ્તા 1,000 દિવસ સુધી તેનો સવાબ લખતા રહે તો પણ લખી ન શકે.
dhikrs.hin_short_name: दुरूद पढ़ने पर 1,000 फ़रिश्ते सवाब लिखते हैं
dhikrs.hin_full_name: जज़ल्लाहु अन्ना सैय्यिदिना मुहम्मदन सल्लल्लाहु तआला अलैहि व आलिही व सल्लम बिमा हुवा अह्लुह
dhikrs.hin_fazilat: स्रोत के अनुसार हज़रत अब्दुल वहाब शअरानी रहमतुल्लाहि तआला अलैह ने 'मीज़ान' में नक़ल फ़रमाया है कि जो शख़्स इस दुरूद शरीफ़ को एक मर्तबा पढ़ेगा, इतना सवाब पाएगा कि अगर 1,000 फ़रिश्ते 70 दिन तक या 70 फ़रिश्ते 1,000 दिन तक उसके सवाब को लिखें तो न लिख सकेंगे।
dhikrs.ur_short_name: درود پڑھنے پر 1000 فرشتے ثواب لکھتے ہیں
dhikrs.ur_full_name: جَزَی اللّٰہُ عَنَّا سَیِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّی اللّٰہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَا ھُوَ اَھْلُہٗ
dhikrs.ur_fazilat: ماخذ میں حضرت عبدالوہاب شعرانی رحمۃ اللہ تعالیٰ علیہ کے حوالے سے 'میزان' میں نقل کیا گیا ہے کہ جو شخص اس درود شریف کو ایک مرتبہ پڑھے گا وہ اتنا ثواب پائے گا کہ اگر 1000 فرشتے 70 دن تک یا 70 فرشتے 1000 دن تک اس کے ثواب کو لکھیں تو نہ لکھ سکیں گے۔
dhikrs.ar_short_name: صلاة جزى الله عنا محمداً ﷺ
dhikrs.ar_full_name: جَزَى اللَّهُ عَنَّا سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ
dhikrs.ar_fazilat: ينقلُ المصدرُ عن الإمامِ عبدِ الوهابِ الشعرانيِّ رحمهُ اللهُ في الميزانِ أنَّ من قرأَ هذهِ الصيغةَ مرةً واحدةً يُكتبُ لهُ أجرٌ عظيمٌ لا يفرغُ من كتابتِهِ ألفُ مَلَكٍ في سبعينَ يوماً أو سبعونَ مَلَكاً في ألفِ يومٍ.
dhikrs.sw_full_name: Jazallaahu 'annaa Sayyidanaa Muhammadan swallallaahu ta'aalaa 'alayhi wa aalihi wa sallam bimaa huwa ahluh
dhikrs.sw_fazilat: Chanzo kinanukuu kutoka kwa Imam 'Abd al-Wahhab al-Sha'rani (rehema za Allah ziwe juu yake) katika kitabu cha al-Mizan kuwa yeyote atakayesoma salawat hii mara moja atapata thawabu nyingi kiasi kwamba hata malaika 1,000 wakiandika thawabu zake kwa siku 70 au malaika 70 kwa siku 1,000 hawataweza kumaliza kuziandika.

meaning.en: May Allah reward our master Muhammad ﷺ, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him and his family, on our behalf as befits his noble station.
meaning.guj: અલ્લાહ તઆલા અમારી તરફથી અમારા સરદાર મુહમ્મદ ﷺ (અને તેમની આલ) ને તેવો બદલો અતા ફરમાવે જેવા તેઓ લાયક છે.
meaning.hin: अल्लाह तआला हमारी तरफ़ से हमारे सरदार मुहम्मद ﷺ (और आपकी आल) को वह बदला अता फ़रमाए जिसके आप हक़दार हैं।
meaning.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ ہماری طرف سے ہمارے سردار محمد ﷺ (اور آپ کی آل) کو وہ جزا عطا فرمائے جس کے آپ اہل ہیں۔
meaning.ar: الدعاءُ بأنْ يجزيَ اللهُ عنَّا نبيَّنا محمداً ﷺ وآلَهُ خيرَ ما هوَ أهلُهُ.
meaning.sw: Mwenyezi Mungu amlipe bwana wetu Muhammad ﷺ, amani na rehema za Mwenyezi Mungu ziwe juu yake na jamaa zake, kwa niaba yetu malipo yanayomstahiki.

references.source_text: Attributed in source to 'Abd al-Wahhab al-Sha'rani in al-Mizan; the similar Hadith from Ibn 'Abbas RA (al-Tabarani, al-Mu'jam al-Awsat #235 and al-Kabir #11509; Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya') is graded very weak / munkar in classical Hadith criticism (al-Haythami, Ibn Hajar, al-Albani Silsilah Da'ifah #5109) due to Hani' ibn al-Mutawakkil.

source.original_title: દુરૂદ પઢ઼ને પર 1000 ફ઼રિશ્તે સવાબ લિખતે હૈ
source.original_recitation: જઝલ્લાહુ અન્ના સૈયદીના મુહમ્મદન સલ્લલ્લાહુ તઆલા અલયહી વ આલીહી વસલ્લમ બિમા હુવ અહ્'લુહુ
source.original_fazilat: હજ઼રત અબ્દુલ વહાબ શઅરાની رَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ تَعَالٰى عَلَيْه ને મિજાન મેં નકલ ફરમાયા હૈ કે, "જો શખ્સ ઇસ દુરુદ શરીફ કો એક મરતબા પઢ઼ેગા ઇતના સવાબ પાએગા કે અગર 1000 ફરિશ્તે 70 દિન તક યા 70 ફરિશ્તે 1000 દિન તક ઉસકે સવાબ કો લિખે તો ન લિખ સકેંગે।"

review_notes: Original index and detail titles are written in Gujarati-script Urdu/Hindustani ('દુરૂદ પઢ઼ને પર 1000 ફ઼રિશ્તે સવાબ લિખતે હૈ'); standardized Gujarati, Hindi, Urdu, English, Arabic, and Swahili titles provided.

Source-attributed reward claim (1,000 angels / 70 days or 70 angels / 1,000 days unable to finish recording reward) is cited from al-Sha'rani's al-Mizan; classical Hadith critics (al-Haythami, Ibn Hajar, al-Albani) grade the related Ibn 'Abbas report in al-Tabarani (al-Awsat #235, al-Kabir #11509) as very weak / munkar due to narrator Hani' ibn al-Mutawakkil. Requires scholarly review.

dhikrs.en_short_name: Durood for Increase in Wealth and Provision
dhikrs.en_full_name: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasulika wa 'ala al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minati wa 'ala al-muslimina wa al-muslimat
dhikrs.en_fazilat: The source cites Ruh al-Bayan, Abu al-'Aliyah, and a narration from Abu Sa'id (radiyAllahu 'anhu), associating this Durood in its title with seeking increase in wealth and sustenance.
dhikrs.guj_full_name: અલ્લાહુમ્મ સલ્લી અલા મુહમ્મદીન અબ્દિક વ રસુલિક વ અલલ્ મુઅમીનીન વલ્ મુઅમીનાતિ વ અલલ્ મુસ્લિમીન વલ્ મુસ્લિમાત
dhikrs.guj_fazilat: મૂળ સ્ત્રોતમાં તેના શીર્ષક હેઠળ 'રૂહુલ બયાન', 'અબુલ આલિયા' અને 'અબુ સઈદ રદિયલ્લાહુ તઆલા અન્હુ' નો હવાલો આપવામાં આવ્યો છે.
dhikrs.hin_full_name: अल्लाहुम्मा सल्लि अला मुहम्मदिन अब्दिका व रसूलिका व अलल मुमिनीन वल मुमिनाति व अलल मुस्लिमीन वल मुस्लिमात
dhikrs.hin_fazilat: स्रोत में इसके शीर्षक के साथ 'रूहल बयान', 'अबुल आलिया' और 'अबू सईद रज़ियल्लाहु तआला अन्हु' की रिवायत का हवाला दिया गया है।
dhikrs.ur_short_name: مال و دولت بڑھنے کے لیے درود
dhikrs.ur_full_name: اَللّٰھُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِکَ وَرَسُوْلِکَ وَعَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَعَلَی الْمُسْلِمِیْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ
dhikrs.ur_fazilat: ماخذ میں اس کے عنوان کے ساتھ 'روح البیان'، 'ابو العالیہ' اور 'حضرت ابو سعید رضی اللہ تعالیٰ عنہ' کی روایت کا حوالہ دیا گیا ہے۔
dhikrs.ar_full_name: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَعَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ
dhikrs.ar_fazilat: يشيرُ المصدرُ إلى (روح البيان) و(أبي العالية) و(أبي سعيد رضي الله عنه)، مع نسبةِ الدعاءِ بسعةِ الرزقِ والمالِ في العنوانِ.
dhikrs.sw_short_name: Salawat ya Kuomba Baraka na Riziki
dhikrs.sw_full_name: Allahumma swalli 'alaa Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasuulika wa 'alaa al-mu'miniina wa al-mu'minaati wa 'alaa al-muslimiina wa al-muslimaat
dhikrs.sw_fazilat: Chanzo kinanukuu rejea za 'Ruh al-Bayan', 'Abu al-'Aliyah', na riwaya kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id (radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake), kikihusisha salawat hii katika kichwa chake na kuomba baraka ya mali na riziki.

meaning.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad ﷺ, Your servant and Your Messenger, and upon the believing men and believing women, and upon the Muslim men and Muslim women.
meaning.guj: હે અલ્લાહ, આપના બંદા અને રસૂલ મુહમ્મદ ﷺ પર, તથા તમામ મોમિન પુરુષો, મોમિન સ્ત્રીઓ, મુસ્લિમ પુરુષો અને મુસ્લિમ સ્ત્રીઓ પર રહમત નાઝિલ ફરમાવ.
meaning.hin: ऐ अल्लाह, अपने बंदे और रसूल मुहम्मद ﷺ पर, और तमाम मोमिन मर्दों व मोमिन औरतों तथा मुस्लिम मर्दों व मुस्लिम औरतों पर रहमत नाज़िल फ़रमा।
meaning.ur: اے اللہ! اپنے بندے اور رسول محمد ﷺ پر، اور تمام مؤمن مردوں و مؤمن عورتوں اور مسلمان مردوں و مسلمان عورتوں پر رحمت نازل فرما۔
meaning.ar: دعاءٌ نبويٌّ مأثورٌ بالصلاةِ على النبيِّ محمدٍ ﷺ عبدِ اللهِ ورسولِهِ، وعلى المؤمنينَ والمؤمناتِ والمسلمينَ والمسلماتِ.
meaning.sw: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, mshushie rehema Muhammad ﷺ, mja Wako na Mtume Wako, na juu ya wanaume Waumini na wanawake Waumini, na juu ya wanaume Waislamu na wanawake Waislamu.

references.source_text: Source cites Ruh al-Bayan (Ismail Haqqi al-Burusawi, tafsir of Surah al-Ahzab 33:56 citing Abu al-'Aliyah on the meaning of salat) and a narration from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri RA (Sahih Ibn Hibban / al-Adab al-Mufrad) framing this supplication as spiritual charity (sadaqah) for one who lacks wealth.

source.original_recitation: અલ્લાહુમ્મ સલ્લી અલા મુહમ્મદીન અબ્દિક વ રસુલિક વ અલલ્ મુઅમીનીન વલ્ મુઅમીનાતિ વ અલલ્ મુસ્લિમીન વલ્ મુસ્લિમાત
source.original_fazilat: રુહુલ્ બયાન\n અબુલ્ આલિ \n અન્‌ અબુ સઈદ રદીઅલ્લાહુ તઆલા અન્હુ

review_notes: Original index and detail titles are written in Gujarati-script Urdu/Hindustani ('માલ-દૌલત બઢ઼ને કે લિએ દુરુદ'); translated into standard Gujarati and other languages while keeping raw source title untouched.
Near-duplicate recitation of position 12 (durood_sadqa); position 44 omits the second 'wa salli' and repeats 'wa 'ala' before 'al-muslimin'. Both entries retained in original positions.

Source title frames this Durood as a means to increase material wealth, whereas Ruh al-Bayan cites Abu al-'Aliyah on Surah 33:56 and the classical Hadith of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri RA (Ibn Hibban / al-Adab al-Mufrad) presents this supplication as spiritual charity (sadaqah) for those without wealth to give in alms. Requires scholarly review.

dhikrs.en_short_name: Durood for Forgiveness of 80 Years of Sins
dhikrs.en_full_name: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin an-Nabiyyi al-Ummiyyi wa 'ala alihi wa sallim
dhikrs.en_fazilat: The source cites a narration attributed to 'Sahl bin (radiyAllahu ta'ala 'anhu)' and references al-Qawl al-Badi' (p. 196), stating that whoever recites this Durood 80 times on Friday after the 'Asr prayer will have 80 years of sins forgiven by Allah ﷻ.
dhikrs.guj_short_name: દુરૂદ પઢવા પર 80 વર્ષના ગુનાહ માફ થશે
dhikrs.guj_full_name: અલ્લાહુમ્મ સલ્લી અલા સય્યીદીના મુહમ્મદીનીન્નબીય્યીલ્ ઉમ્મીય્યી વ અલા આલિહી વસલ્લિમ
dhikrs.guj_fazilat: મૂળ સ્ત્રોતમાં 'સહલ બિન રદિયલ્લાહુ તઆલા અન્હુ' ના હવાલાથી 'અલ-કૌલુલ બદીઅ' (પૃષ્ઠ 196) નો સંદર્ભ આપીને બયાન કરવામાં આવ્યું છે કે શુક્રવારે અસરની નમાઝ પછી 80 વખત આ દુરૂદ પઢનારના અલ્લાહ ﷻ 80 વર્ષના ગુનાહ માફ ફરમાવી દેશે.
dhikrs.hin_short_name: दुरूद पढ़ने पर 80 साल के गुनाह माफ़ होंगे
dhikrs.hin_full_name: अल्लाहुम्मा सल्लि अला सैय्यिदिना मुहम्मदिनिन नबिय्यिल उम्मिय्यि व अला आलिही व सल्लिम
dhikrs.hin_fazilat: स्रोत में 'सहल बिन रज़ियल्लाहु तआला अन्हु' की रिवायत और किताब 'अल-क़ौलुल बदीअ' (सफ़ा 196) के हवाले से बयान किया गया है कि जो शख़्स जुम्आ के दिन असर के बाद 80 बार यह दुरूद पढ़े, अल्लाह ﷻ उसके 80 साल के गुनाह माफ़ फ़रमा देगा।
dhikrs.ur_short_name: درود پڑھنے پر 80 سال کے گناہ معاف ہوں گے
dhikrs.ur_full_name: اَللّٰھُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی سَیِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِیِّ الْاُمِّیِّ وَعَلٰی اٰلِہٖ وَسَلِّمْ
dhikrs.ur_fazilat: ماخذ میں 'سہل بن رضی اللہ تعالیٰ عنہ' کے حوالے سے اور کتاب 'القول البدیع' (صفحہ 196) کے حوالہ سے نقل کیا گیا ہے کہ جمعہ کے روز عصر کے بعد 80 مرتبہ یہ درود پڑھنے سے اللہ تعالیٰ اس کے 80 سال کے گناہ معاف فرما دے گا۔
dhikrs.ar_full_name: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
dhikrs.ar_fazilat: يذكرُ المصدرُ روايةً منسوبةً لـ(سهل بن رضي الله عنه) وإحالةً إلى كتابِ (القول البديع، ص 196) بأنَّ قراءةَ هذهِ الصيغةِ ثمانينَ مرةً بعدَ عصرِ يومِ الجمعةِ يُغفرُ بها ذنوبُ ثمانينَ سنةً.
dhikrs.sw_short_name: Salawat ya Msamaha wa Dhambi za Miaka 80
dhikrs.sw_full_name: Allahumma swalli 'alaa Sayyidinaa Muhammadin an-Nabiyyi al-Ummiyyi wa 'alaa aalihi wa sallim
dhikrs.sw_fazilat: Chanzo kinanukuu riwaya inayohusishwa na 'Sahl bin (radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake)' na kurejelea kitabu cha 'al-Qawl al-Badi'' (uk. 196), kikieleza kuwa yeyote atakayesoma salawat hii mara 80 siku ya Ijumaa baada ya swala ya Alasiri, Mwenyezi Mungu ﷻ atamsamehe dhambi zake za miaka 80.

meaning.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad ﷺ, the unlettered Prophet, and upon his family, and grant peace.
meaning.guj: હે અલ્લાહ, અમારા સરદાર અને ઉમ્મી નબી મુહમ્મદ ﷺ તથા તેમની આલ પર રહમત અને સલામતી નાઝિલ ફરમાવ.
meaning.hin: ऐ अल्लाह, हमारे सरदार और उम्मी नबी मुहम्मद ﷺ तथा उनकी आल पर रहमत और सलामती नाज़िल फ़रमा।
meaning.ur: اے اللہ! ہمارے سردار نبی امی محمد ﷺ پر اور آپ کی آل پر رحمت اور سلامتی نازل فرما۔
meaning.ar: طلبُ الصلاةِ والسلامِ على سيدِنا محمدٍ النبيِّ الأميِّ ﷺ وعلى آلِهِ.
meaning.sw: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, mshushie rehema bwana wetu Muhammad ﷺ, Nabii asiyejua kusoma wala kuandika, na juu ya jamaa zake, na umpe amani.

references.source_text: al-Sakhawi, al-Qawl al-Badi', p. 196 (source cites 'સહલ બિન રદિયલ્લાહુ તઆલા અન્હુ' — truncated name corresponding to Sahl ibn 'Abdullah cited via Ibn Bashkuwal alongside a marfu' report from Abu Hurayrah RA regarding 80 recitations on Friday).

source.original_title: દુરૂદ પઢ઼ને પર 80 સાલ કે ગુનાહ માફ હોંગે
source.original_recitation: અલ્લાહુમ્મ સલ્લી અલા સય્યીદીના મુહમ્મદીનીન્નબીય્યીલ્ ઉમ્મીય્યી વ અલા આલિહી વસલ્લિમ
source.original_fazilat:
સહલ બિન رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ تَعَالٰى عَنْهُ સે રિવાયત હૈ કિ રસુલુલ્લાહ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَآلِهٖ وَسَلَّم ને ફરમાયા "જુમ્આ રોજ઼ અસર કે બાદ 80 બાર યહ દુરુદ પઢ઼ે અલ્લાહ ﷻ ઉસકે 80 સાલ કે ગુનાહ માફ ફરમા દેગા।"
અલ્ કૌલુલ બદીઅ, સફા : 196

review_notes: Original index and detail titles are written in Gujarati-script Urdu/Hindustani ('દુરૂદ પઢ઼ને પર 80 સાલ કે ગુનાહ માફ હોંગે'); translated into standard Gujarati and other languages.

Source narration prints a truncated attribution ('સહલ બિન رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ تَعَالٰى عَنْهُ', missing father's name), corresponding to Sahl ibn 'Abdullah mentioned in al-Sakhawi's al-Qawl al-Badi' (p. 196) alongside a report from Abu Hurayrah RA.

Classical Hadith critics (al-Sakhawi, al-'Iraqi, al-Albani) grade the specific 80-times-on-Friday / 80-years-of-sins-forgiven narrations as weak (da'if), although sending abundant Salawat on Friday is authentically established in Sahih Hadith. Requires scholarly review.

structural_validation.near_duplicate_threshold_note: Pairs with SequenceMatcher similarity >= 0.78 on both diacritic-stripped Arabic and normalized English transliteration.

religious_verification.note: Structural extraction, Durood-e-Kashaf reconstruction, and multilingual formatting passed validation; scholarly religious verification remains outstanding for items with open review_issues or review_status='needs_review'.

review_issues.description: Arabic text was previously unresolved due to corrupted Gujarati transliteration segments. Phrase-for-phrase Arabic matching against circulated Sufi/Naqshbandi 'Salat al-Kashf wa al-Anwar wa al-Asrar' texts is now complete, while critical printed edition citation and creedal/Hadith review remain open.
review_issues.resolution: Populated ar_full_name, corrected all five transliteration fields (en/guj/hin/ur/sw_full_name), added complete meanings in all six languages, updated source.arabic_origin to 'externally_verified', and documented the unauthenticated embedded saying and direct istighatha/ya qadiya al-hajat creedal notes.
supporting_sources: Circulated Arabic texts of 'Salat al-Kashf wa al-Anwar wa al-Asrar' / 'Salat al-Kashf al-Mubin' in Naqshbandi/Qadiri awrad literature.
South Asian devotional compendium '25 Durood-e-Kashf o Mushahadat' by Faqir 'Abd al-'Aziz Rida Habibi Chishti Qadiri (Internet Archive).
Hadith verification note on 'man 'usirat 'alayhi hajatun...': non-canonical wording vs. established general theme in al-Tirmidhi (Hadith of Ubayy ibn Ka'b RA).

review_issues.description: Detail layout header title uses Devanagari Hindi ('दुरुदे कशफ') instead of Gujarati ('દુરૂદે કશફ' in durood_inside.xml).
review_issues.resolution: Normalized all six localized short_name fields consistently in their respective scripts while preserving the raw Devanagari header verbatim in source.detail_header_title.
supporting_sources: durood_inside.xml ('દુરૂદે કશફ') vs. durood_kashaf.xml ('दुरुदे कशफ').

review_issues.description: Source Gujarati transliteration reads 'સાહીબીસ્સરાબી વલ્ અતા યા' and 'મહ્યુદીલ્' (apparent corruptions of 'sahibi al-saraya wa al-'ataya' and 'al-mahmudi'). Reconstructed Arabic follows standard attested Durood-e-Akbar wording and requires scholarly verification.
review_issues.resolution: Verified exact attested Arabic ('sahibi al-saraya wa al-'ataya', 'sahibi al-maqami al-mahmudi wa al-hawdi al-mawrudi'), fixed remaining Gujarati corruptions in guj_full_name, updated source.arabic_origin to 'externally_verified', and marked review_status 'verified' while preserving raw XML in source.original_recitation.
supporting_sources: Standard printed South Asian Durood-e-Akbar texts matching 'صاحب السرايا والعطايا صاحب المقام المحمود والحوض المورود'.

review_issues.description: Source Gujarati transliteration of Salawat al-Nuraniyyah (al-Badawi) contains several transcription corruptions ('મન્દીનિલ્', 'ઈસ્તફાનિય્યતિ', 'વલૂ બજતિસ્ સુનિય્યતિ', 'મિનદ્દરજતિ', 'અસ્નૈત') and omits 'wa ahyayta'. Reconstructed Arabic requires scholarly verification.
review_issues.resolution: Verified the source composition as an abridged South Asian recension of Sayyid Ahmad al-Badawi's Salawat al-Nuraniyyah, fixed all Gujarati transcription corruptions in guj_full_name, updated source.arabic_origin to 'externally_verified', and preserved the source's omitted-clause sequence without silent insertion; scholarly review remains open for the abridged recension and Sufi metaphysical terms.
supporting_sources: Standard printed texts of Salawat al-Nuraniyyah (Sayyid Ahmad al-Badawi RA) comparing omitted phrases ('wa afdali al-khaliqati...', 'wa sahbihi', 'wa ahyayta').

review_issues.description: Titled 'Durood-e-Khamsah' (five-fold Durood), but only four 'wa salli 'ala Muhammadin' clauses are present in the source XML (omitting 'bi-'adadi man lam yusalli 'alayhi'). Preserved as four clauses without fabrication; requires scholarly review.
review_issues.resolution: Confirmed that South Asian Durood manuals (e.g., Tohfat-ul-Maqasid, Khazina-e-Durood) present Durood-e-Khamsah as a five-fold composition whose first four clauses match durood_khamsah.xml verbatim, while the fifth clause varies across editions. Cleaned U+200C and vowel typos in guj_full_name without inserting an unattested fifth clause.
supporting_sources: South Asian Durood compendia (Tohfat-ul-Maqasid, Khazina-e-Durood) on Durood-e-Khamsah's four opening clauses.

review_issues.description: Source Gujarati prints 'મદીનીલ્' four times instead of 'મઅ્દિનીલ્' (ma'dini) and 'સખ્ખરુ' instead of 'sakhkhir'. Reconstructed Arabic requires verification.
review_issues.resolution: Corrected the four occurrences of 'મદીનીલ્' to 'મઅ્દિનિલ' (ma'dini) and 'સખ્ખરુ' to 'સખ્ખિર' (sakhkhir) in guj_full_name, and refined sun-letter assimilation in hin_full_name, while keeping raw XML untouched in source.original_recitation. Devotional authorship/origin remains flagged for scholarly review.
supporting_sources: Arabic morphological verification of ma'dini al-judi... and imperative sakhkhir wa allif in Durood-e-Taskhir devotional texts.

review_issues.description: Source Gujarati accidentally repeats 'વ અલા આલિ મુહમ્મદીવ્વ' twice and prints 'લમ્ યલિદુ વલમ્ યુલદુ' instead of the Quranic jussive 'lam yalid wa lam yulad' (112:3).
review_issues.resolution: Removed the accidentally duplicated 'વ અલા આલિ મુહમ્મદીવ્વ' phrase and corrected the Quranic jussive ending to 'લમ્ યલિદ્ વ લમ્ યૂલદ્' (Surah al-Ikhlas 112:3) in guj_full_name, matching all other five language fields while keeping raw XML untouched in source.original_recitation.
supporting_sources: Qur'an, Surah al-Ikhlas (112:3): 'لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ'.

review_issues.description: Minor Gujarati spelling omissions ('મીઆજી', 'મુકધસુમ્', 'કફીલ્', 'જીબીલુ', omitted 'ibni' before 'Abdillah') and insertion of 'Muhammadur-Rasulullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam' before 'nurin min nurillah'. Contains devotional epithets requiring contextual review.
review_issues.resolution: Replaced decorative '૦', '०', and '۝' pause markers across all localized *_full_name fields with neutral ' • ' separators and corrected Gujarati spelling omissions in guj_full_name while preserving source.original_recitation verbatim. Devotional epithets remain flagged for scholarly contextualization.
supporting_sources: Standard printed South Asian Durood-e-Taaj texts.

review_issues.description: Source Gujarati prints 'તક્દી લા' (missing 'ન' in 'lana') and 'ઈનક' (for 'innaka').
review_issues.resolution: Corrected 'તક્દી લા' -> 'તક્ઝી લના', 'જમીઈસ્સી આતી' -> 'જમીઇસ્ સય્યિઆતિ', and 'ઈનક' -> 'ઇન્નક' in guj_full_name, matching all other five languages while preserving source.original_recitation verbatim.
supporting_sources: Standard printed texts of al-Salat al-Munjiyah (Durood-e-Tunajjina).

review_issues.description: Source Gujarati omits preposition 'અલા' ('ala) before 'હબીબીકલ્ મુજ્તબા'.
review_issues.resolution: Restored the omitted preposition 'અલા' ('ala) before 'હબીબીકલ્ મુજ્તબા' in guj_full_name, bringing all six localized recitation fields into alignment while preserving source.original_recitation verbatim.
supporting_sources: Standard Arabic prepositional syntax ('salli wa sallim wa barik 'ala Habibika').

review_issues.description: Provisional English spelling 'Durood-e-Azaz' corrected to 'Durood-e-Ejaz (Ijaz)' matching source Gujarati 'દુરૂદે એજાજ઼' while retaining seed_key 'durood_azaz'.
review_issues.resolution: Corrected guj_full_name verb ending from 'અલીમત્' to 'અલિમ્ત' ('alimta) consistently with Arabic and the other transliterations while retaining seed_key 'durood_azaz' for database compatibility.
supporting_sources: durood_azaz.xml source text ('દુરૂદે એજાજ઼') and Arabic 2nd-person singular 'alimta.

review_issues.description: Eschatological reward claim (seeing the Prophet ﷺ at death and in the grave) is attributed to 'Salawat ala Sayyid al-Sadat, p. 151' (devotional work), not an authenticated Hadith; requires scholarly verification.
review_issues.resolution: Identified the cited book as Yusuf ibn Isma'il al-Nabhani's devotional anthology Afdal al-Salawat 'ala Sayyid al-Sadat (which quotes scholars such as al-Suyuti, al-Sawi, and Ahmad Dahlan on Salawat al-'Ali al-Qadr) rather than a canonical Prophetic Hadith; updated references and review_notes accordingly.

review_issues.description: Reward claim (1,000 angels / 70 days unable to record reward) is attributed to al-Sha'rani's al-Mizan; similar Hadith reports from Ibn 'Abbas are graded weak in classical Hadith criticism. Requires scholarly verification.

review_issues.description: Title frames this Durood as a means for increasing wealth and prosperity, whereas the classical Hadith of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri RA frames it as spiritual charity for those without wealth. Requires scholarly review.
review_issues.resolution: Documented that Ismail Haqqi al-Burusawi's Ruh al-Bayan (on Surah al-Ahzab 33:56) cites Abu al-'Aliyah on the meaning of salat, while the classical Hadith of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri RA (Sahih Ibn Hibban / al-Adab al-Mufrad) frames this supplication as spiritual charity (sadaqah) for those without wealth—not a guaranteed means of increasing material wealth.
supporting_sources: Ismail Haqqi al-Burusawi, Tafsir Ruh al-Bayan (Surah 33:56).
Hadith of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri RA in Sahih Ibn Hibban and al-Bukhari's al-Adab al-Mufrad.

review_issues.description: Claim of forgiveness of 80 years of sins on Friday after 'Asr is attributed to 'Sahl bin RA' (truncated narrator name) and al-Qawl al-Badi' p. 196; graded weak (da'if) in Hadith criticism. Requires scholarly verification.
review_issues.resolution: Clarified that the truncated attribution 'સહલ બિન રદિયલ્લાહુ તઆલા અન્હુ' corresponds to Sahl ibn 'Abdullah cited in al-Sakhawi's al-Qawl al-Badi' (p. 196) alongside a report from Abu Hurayrah RA, and that classical Hadith critics (al-Sakhawi, al-'Iraqi, al-Albani) grade the fixed 80-times-on-Friday / 80-years-forgiveness reports as weak (da'if).
supporting_sources: Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Sakhawi, al-Qawl al-Badi' fi al-Salat 'ala al-Habib al-Shafi' (p. 196).
